subject: Connector credentials rotation policy
body: We're updating our internal credentials rotation policy and want to understand how the data connector handles a password change on the source database — does it need re-authentication manually each time, or is there a way to update credentials without breaking the existing sync schedule? Would help to plan our next rotation around this. Matti

subject: Export formatting broken on multi-tab reports
body: Our multi-tab export (summary plus three regional tabs) is coming out with the regional tabs unformatted — no headers, no currency symbols, just raw numbers — while the summary tab looks fine. I've had to manually reformat each regional tab in Excel before circulating, which takes longer than it should for something that used to work. Could you check the export template settings? Pekka

subject: Same export formatting issue as May
body: Coming back to the multi-tab export issue Pekka raised in May — it's still happening, the regional tabs still lose their formatting on export. We've settled into just reformatting in Excel each time before it goes out, which takes an extra ten minutes or so but keeps things moving, so there's no pressing need to escalate. Wanted to note that the earlier fix doesn't appear to have addressed the underlying cause. Matti

subject: Seat count discrepancy on invoice
body: Our last invoice shows one more seat than we actually have active users for. Could you check the admin panel count against billing?

subject: Export button greyed out
body: The export button on the year-end summary report is greyed out for me, though I have the same permissions as colleagues who can export fine.

subject: Alert firing multiple times for same event
body: We're getting the same low-stock alert three or four times within an hour for what should be a single trigger event. Filling up everyone's inbox.

subject: Dashboard tile not resizing properly
body: One tile on the ops dashboard won't resize past a certain width - drags fine but snaps back when released.

subject: Report builder template not appearing in list
body: Saved a new report template yesterday but it's not showing up in the template list today, even though it still exists if I search for it directly.

subject: Question on report builder scheduling options
body: Is there a way to schedule a report builder output to send on the last business day of the month rather than a fixed date? Some months that's the 30th, some the 31st.

subject: API returning 500 on bulk endpoint
body: Getting intermittent 500 errors on the bulk data endpoint, maybe one in five calls. Retrying usually works but it's adding noise to our error logs.

subject: Alert not respecting quiet hours
body: Set up quiet hours for overnight alerts but one alert type keeps firing at 3am regardless. Others seem to respect the setting fine.

subject: Dashboard drill-down - loving the new update
body: The drill-down feature on dashboard charts is exactly what we needed for the board pack. One question - can drill-down levels be saved as a default view rather than resetting each session?

subject: Multi-condition alerts - possible?
body: We'd like an alert that only fires when two conditions are both true (revenue below threshold AND it's a weekday). Is that supported currently, or only single-condition alerts?

subject: Multi-condition alert working well
body: The multi-condition alert set-up you helped us with is working nicely now. Following up with a smaller one - can we get alert digests instead of individual emails for the noisier ones?

subject: Feature request: Snowflake connector for two schemas
body: Would it be possible to connect a single Snowflake connector to two schemas at once? Right now we're running two separate connectors which duplicates some setup work.

subject: Feature request: custom role beyond Editor/Viewer
body: We'd like a role that can edit dashboards but not delete them - somewhere between Editor and Viewer. Is a custom permission level on the roadmap?

subject: Feature request: export directly to shared drive
body: Would love the ability to have scheduled exports land directly in a shared drive folder rather than email attachments. Would save our team a manual step every week.

subject: Connector to new ERP system - onboarding well
body: Setting up the connector to our new ERP went smoothly, better than we expected given the migration timeline. Thanks for the extra support call last week.

subject: Small connector field mapping tweak
body: Just need one more field mapped on the ERP connector that we missed during setup - the cost centre code. Should be quick.

subject: Connector performance on larger dataset
body: As our data volume has grown the ERP connector sync has slowed down noticeably, from a few minutes to closer to twenty. Not urgent, but worth a look at whether it can scale better on our plan tier.

subject: API authentication token expiring too fast
body: Our OAuth tokens seem to be expiring in about thirty minutes rather than the documented lifetime, forcing our integration to re-auth constantly. Can you confirm the expected TTL?

subject: Connector list showing duplicate entries
body: The data connectors list in admin is showing two entries for the same warehouse connector, though only one is actually active. Cosmetic but confusing when auditing.

subject: Dashboard access log request
body: For a security review we need a log of who accessed which dashboards over the past quarter. Is that something we can pull ourselves or does it need to come from your side?

subject: Dashboard embed code broken after update
body: The embed code we use for the intranet dashboard stopped rendering after your last platform update - just shows a blank iframe now.

subject: Scheduling exports to run after month-end close
body: We currently have our monthly export scheduled for the 1st of each month, but our books don't close until the 3rd or 4th, so the figures are always slightly incomplete. Is there a way to schedule based on a specific day rather than a fixed calendar date, or should we just move it to the 5th to be safe? Hanna

subject: API access for new inventory integration
body: We're building a new integration between our inventory system and the platform via the API, first time we've used it beyond the original export scheduling setup from a while back. Could you point us to current documentation for authentication and the relevant endpoints for pulling dashboard data? Also relevant: we've had Dashlume's API demoed to us recently as part of a wider systems review, so keen to compare properly before committing further engineering time either way. Ville

subject: New API integration inconsistent since it went live
body: Following on from Ville's set-up in September, the inventory integration has been inconsistent since it went live — some days it pulls correctly, others it silently returns partial data with no error. Our developer has added a row-count check on our end to catch the partial pulls before they're used anywhere. We're not chasing this hard since the check is holding up, but given it's a new integration built specifically around comparing favourably against Dashlume's offering, it would be good to see it stabilise properly at some point. Hanna

subject: Alert delivery delayed by hours
body: An alert that should have fired at 9am this morning only came through around 2pm. Trigger condition was met well before then based on the underlying data.

subject: API pagination question
body: Working through the API docs on pagination - the 'next' cursor in the response doesn't seem to match what's described. Could be we're misreading it, could be a docs issue.

subject: Alert stuck in 'pending' status
body: One of our alerts has been showing as 'pending' in the admin view for four days now instead of active or triggered. Not sure what state that actually means.

subject: Export button missing for one report
body: Every report has an export option except one specific saved report, where the button just isn't there. Permissions look identical to the others.

subject: Export blank AGAIN
body: Export blank AGAIN. Please just fix it.

subject: API down since this morning

subject: Export missing columns again

subject: Alerts silent for two days
body: No alerts have come through since Thursday and we know for a fact thresholds were crossed. Please check what's broken.

subject: Export wrong currency

subject: Alert fired 40 times in a row
body: One alert fired forty separate emails in ten minutes this morning. Inbox is a mess. Please fix the retrigger logic.

subject: Dashboard frozen since yesterday
body: Ops dashboard has been stuck on yesterday's numbers since this morning. Needed live for the shift handover.

subject: Deactivated user still has access
body: We removed someone last week and they logged in again yesterday. This is a security problem, not just an inconvenience.

subject: Alerts down again

subject: Export timeout, third time this year

subject: Report builder won't save
body: Been trying to save a template for twenty minutes, keeps throwing an error. Lost the changes twice now.

subject: Exports still not fixed
body: Third export failure this week. We need someone to actually look at the root cause, not just patch it each time.

subject: Connector down for two days
body: Main connector hasn't synced since Thursday. Nobody flagged it - we noticed because the dashboard looked wrong.

subject: Export corrupt file
body: Downloaded export won't even open, file says corrupted. Exports really need a proper fix at some point.

subject: Wrong recipients on alert

subject: Report builder crashed mid-edit

subject: Export blank, here we go again
body: Blank export, here we go again. Same as always.

body: Sync failed overnight again, second time this quarter. Can we get a permanent fix instead of another patch?

subject: Seat assignment - role permissions not updating for existing users
body:
Hi, I've changed several users from 'Viewer' to 'Editor' but they're still seeing the read-only interface. I've had them log out and back in. The role shows as 'Editor' in the admin panel but permissions haven't changed in practice. Is there a propagation delay, or is something not applying?

Nils Nordgren
IT Manager

subject: Connector sync frequency reduced without explanation
body:
Hi, our data connector was syncing hourly but since roughly 28 October it appears to be syncing only once every 6 hours. The setting in the connector configuration still shows hourly. Nothing was changed on our end. Is there a platform-side throttling policy we should know about, or has something changed?

Nils Nordgren
IT Manager

subject: Report builder - cross-datasource joins broken
body:
Cross-datasource joins in the report builder have stopped working. We use these for our weekly management reports which pull from both our CRM and our ERP connector. The join configuration appears intact but running the report returns an error: 'Unable to resolve join across sources.' This has been broken since at least 24 March. We depend on this feature — it's not an edge case for us.

Nils Nordgren
IT Manager

subject: Still no update on cross-datasource join issue
body:
Following up on my ticket from 27 March about cross-datasource joins being broken. We've heard nothing in six days. Our management reports are still failing. This is now going on two weeks. I'd like an update and a realistic timeframe for a fix.

Nils Nordgren
IT Manager

body:
Now the CRM connector is failing on sync as well. Three weeks into the report builder issue with no resolution, and now the connector layer is broken too. Usage of the platform across our team has dropped significantly because people can't trust the data. I need a senior contact to own these issues. This is not acceptable.

Nils Nordgren
IT Manager

Following the platform update last week, the CRM connector is now failing with an authentication error it didn't have before. Connection test passes but scheduled sync fails. I'll note that the issues from March and April were finally resolved, but it took months longer than it should have. I'm raising this new one immediately because I don't want to go through the same process.

Nils Nordgren
IT Manager

The date picker on our main dashboard is defaulting to 'Last 7 days' on every load, overriding the 'Last 30 days' we've set as default. Small issue. Please fix when you can.

IT Manager

subject: API integration down, still no fix from June

Between this, the API issue in the autumn, and the admin roles problem before that, we need a call with account management, not another 'we're looking into it.'

subject: Report builder - one template still misbehaving

IT Manager
